props.title: New Article: Seventy Commits This Week. Five of Them Did Anything.

props.text: The agent repo pushed about seventy-five commits this week. Seventy were heartbeat ticks, scheduler updates, and cron markers — the autonomic pulse of a system confirming it is still alive. Five changed something real: two upstream framework syncs absorbing twenty-one commits, three security patches. The 15-to-1 ratio mirrors the 60-70% of energy the human body spends on basal metabolism — and the 70% of IT budgets Gartner says goes to keeping the lights on.
